_comment: The words on every store image: `label` is the numbered mono line, `headline` the big line with its one lime phrase in [brackets], `subline` the grey line. A class name inside a shot overrides those words for that class, where its capture shows something else. Every claim must be true of the shipped app and visible in the image.
